name: mdx-local-execution-triage
fallback_compile_checks: jq empty on changed generated JSON
stop_conditions: direct local native-binary command produces no output after successful compile
sample shows the process parked at _dyld_start
kill -9 does not clear a process in uninterruptible state
same command is covered by CI verify
rules: Local native runtime is authoritative while recovered evidence remains current
If the host hang returns, local binary hangs are host-execution caveats until reproduced in CI
Agents must stop hung local runtime processes before handoff
Agents must stop reproducing the hang after _dyld_start is observed
Agents must cite compile/no-run checks and PR CI only when runtime commands are not locally executable
